title: ShadowTM's
description: ShadowTM's is a plugin for Fabric Servers that adds the ability to add TM's / TR's in Cobblemon mod.
body:
ShadowTM's is a plugin for Fabric Servers that adds the ability to add TM's / TR's in Cobblemon mod.

## 📜**Features**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Easy to use and support for custom model data on the disc items.
- Possibility to set whether you can use any ability on any type of pokemon or not.
And more soon..
- This mod comes with Texture Pack access as an example.

</details>



## 🔒**Permission**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- `shadowtms.reload`
- `shadowtms.give.blank`
- `shadowtms.give`

</details>



## ⚙️**Commands**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- `/stm give <player> <move> <tm|tr> [amount]`
- `/stm give <player> blank <tm|tr> [amount]`
- `/stm reload`

</details>
